scenarios.criterion: scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh, run from the repo root on a machine with Docker, MUST build the image from containers/saturday-runner/Containerfile with --platform linux/amd64 --target debian without changing that Containerfile, mount the checkout at /work with a named pnpm store volume, install dependencies with --frozen-lockfile, start the app and the mock API, run runner-check and then the chrome project in that order, copy the Playwright report to artifacts/ui-suite/, and exit with the suite's exit code.
scenarios.name: The containerized UI suite script builds the merged runner image and runs the suite inside it
given: The repo is checked out on a machine with Docker
when: scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh is run from the repo root
then: The image builds from containers/saturday-runner/Containerfile with --platform linux/amd64 --target debian
Dependencies install inside the container with --frozen-lockfile
The app and the mock API start inside the container
runner-check runs before the chrome project
The chrome project runs only after runner-check succeeds

scenarios.criterion: scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh, run from the repo root on a machine with Docker, MUST ... copy the Playwright report to artifacts/ui-suite/, and exit with the suite's exit code.
scenarios.name: The containerized run produces a Playwright report and exits with the suite's result
given: scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh has finished running the chrome project
then: The Playwright report is copied to artifacts/ui-suite/
The script's exit code matches the chrome project's own exit code

scenarios.criterion: The app and mock API MUST make no request off the container after dependencies are installed.
scenarios.name: The app and mock API make no requests outside the container once dependencies are installed
given: Dependencies have finished installing inside the container
when: The app server and mock API server start and serve the chrome project's requests
then: Neither the app server nor the mock API server makes a network request to a host outside the container

scenarios.criterion: tests/webgl.spec.ts MUST assert a webgl2 context is available on the running app's page.
scenarios.name: The running app exposes a WebGL2 rendering context
given: The chrome project is running against the app inside the container
then: A webgl2 context is available on the page

scenarios.criterion: tests/webgl.spec.ts MUST fail when the browser is launched with --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer added to the chrome project's launch args. That launch MUST be used once as a test-of-the-test and the result recorded in the delivery record.
scenarios.name: Disabling the GPU and software rasterizer makes the WebGL test fail (test-of-the-test)
given: The chrome project's launch args temporarily include --disable-gpu and --disable-software-rasterizer
then: The test fails, proving it can detect a missing WebGL2 context
The failing run's output is captured in the delivery record alongside the normal passing run

scenarios.criterion: If the image fails to build ... the script MUST exit non-zero and state which of the two happened, using an exit code and message distinct from a Playwright test failure's exit code.
scenarios.name: A failed image build is reported distinctly from a test failure
then: The script exits non-zero
The script states that the image build failed
That exit code differs from the exit code a Playwright test failure produces

scenarios.criterion: If ... the app is not healthy within 180 seconds, the script MUST exit non-zero and state which of the two happened, using an exit code and message distinct from a Playwright test failure's exit code.
scenarios.name: An app that never becomes healthy is reported distinctly from a test failure
given: The app does not respond healthy within 180 seconds of starting
then: The script exits non-zero
The script states that the app health check timed out
That exit code differs from the exit code a Playwright test failure produces
